verified: manifest schema version 3 validates one unchanged default, three public Ultralytics detectors, and one public multi-artifact anomaly-map model
General Manufacturing is the coverage-oriented default; Steel Surface and Concrete & Structural Cracks are selectable specialists
all three local checkpoint hashes match immutable source revisions and all three load with task=detect plus exact checkpoint-native classes
all three models execute through DetectionRuntimeManager and DetectionService on domain-scoped remote probes
lazy loading caches successful services by model ID and does not load weights during FastAPI startup or GET /api/models
standard-color preserves BGR channels while steel-enhanced applies grayscale and CLAHE(2.0, 8x8) over the shared letterbox/restore path
quality-v1 uses per-model weights and an explicit neutral default weight of 1.0
POST /api/inspect and POST /api/stream accept optional modelId, share one inference lock, and return the actual model projection
unknown modelId returns 404; a registered missing or invalid checkpoint returns 409 with an installer command
history persists model IDs and remains readable after a historical model leaves the registry by falling back to its persisted ID as display name
GET /api/models exposes domain, description, native classes, default state, preprocessing profile, and verified installed state
frontend loads the registry, selects the installed API default, disables uninstalled entries, shows exact installer commands, and propagates one selection to upload and live requests
changing the selected upload model aborts and sequence-invalidates the active request before clearing preview and result state
changing the selected live model aborts the current frame and clears stale overlay detections
registry installer supports default, explicit --model, and exposed-only --all with per-artifact pinned size/SHA checks and atomic replacement; AnomalyCLIP now intentionally participates in --all
AnomalyCLIP uses backend-owned 518x518 stretch geometry, frozen postprocessing, original-space bbox restoration, and a hash-bound 131-value clean calibration reference

AnomalyCLIP prompt loading requires weights_only=True, its CLIP backbone uses TorchScript loading without pickle fallback, and its score is documented as anomaly confidence rather than class probability
public /api/models serializes four models including anomalyclip-stretch while the default remains factory-defect-guard-v6-mc
AnomalyCLIP preserves prior screw, capsule, tile, normal, cable, and NEU observations through real public inspect/stream requests; history/detail retain its model ID and stream remains non-persistent
frontend mock mode exposes the same four-model selection and preserves each model's native output vocabulary through the generic selector contract
existing upload, stream, history, persistence, filtering, deletion, CSV, annotation, severity, and demo-sample behavior remains covered
frontend tests and Vite production build pass after the multi-model change
Dashboard Quick Upload, Inspect, live stream, and the Samples page share one explicit global model selection
nine offline CC BY 4.0 showcase images cover PCB, steel, and concrete/crack domains with three samples per declared showcase model
showcase PCB, HU, and PLOS labels are reconstructed from tracked source-metadata excerpts, blade labels from source folders, and transformed assets disclose downscaling or cropping
GET /api/samples returns metadata without image payloads and GET /api/samples/{id}/image serves originals only by manifest ID
Inspect sample performs fresh inference with the current model through POST /api/inspect, aborts pending image loads on model change, and persists the resulting history record

known_limitations.detail: AnomalyCLIP is publicly selectable but remains a generic anomaly localizer with a PARTIAL accuracy qualification, a known fragmented cable result, slow CPU inference, and no separately confirmed license statement for the distributed binary checkpoints. It is not the default and specialists remain preferred for known domains.
The broad default uses confidence 0.05 based on observed runtime behavior. Its mixed-domain probe records predictions, including mismatched source labels, and does not claim accuracy superiority.
Source-balanced demo and model qualification runs record observations without computing or claiming benchmark accuracy; accurate boxes/types/confidence remains PARTIAL.
Python API/detection/storage tests, frontend utilities, validators, and production build exist; full React component and browser end-to-end automation remain planned.
